prose: In this reality-rattling episode, Steve Falconer of Spacebusters joins InnerVerse to challenge the official story of Antarctica, and with it, the entire cosmological structure we’ve been taught to trust.

Steve peels back layers of illusion (geographic, scientific, and metaphysical) to reveal a world far stranger and more sacred than we’ve been led to believe. Whether you're globe-weary or just hungry for deeper knowing, this episode is a metaphysical expedition you won’t forget.
topics: The “Final Experiment” video and its deception
Why sun observations at Antarctic bases don’t match any globe model
The mystery of maps, magnetic anomalies, and missing circumnavigations
How spiritual sovereignty connects to cosmic awareness
ext: Parabolic sun illusions and toroidal light fields
The deeper meaning of the Antarctic “theater”
Why the map is wrong, the sun is local, and the realm is electric
